title: Stefan Yasin
description: Notes on infrastructure, AI for small business, and building systems that survive.

items.title: The Real Ops Stack Nobody Talks About
items.summary: The ops stack nobody talks about. Why cross-domain depth across plant systems, BMS networking, IT, and AI pipelines beats single-silo management.

items.title: What a small business should actually monitor
items.summary: Five things, not five hundred. Monitoring works when it pages the right person about the right failure.

items.title: Backups are a promise you have not tested
items.summary: A backup you have never restored is a hope, not a plan. Test it before the bad day decides for you.

items.title: The first 90 days of AI in a small business
items.summary: A calendar, not a demo. Three months of boring automations that pay for themselves before the chatbots arrive.

items.title: The two questions that stop most small business breaches
items.summary: Stored credentials and untested backups cause more damage than exotic malware. Two boring questions fix most of it.

items.title: AI for small business: start with the boring stuff
items.summary: The unglamorous automations pay first. The chatbots come later.

items.title: What plant IT taught me about small business
items.summary: Downtime is measured in dollars per minute in both places. The difference is who feels it.
